title: Facebook Comment Exporter Input
description: Configure the scraper to extract comments and replies from Facebook posts.

postUrls.title: Facebook Post URLs
postUrls.description: List of Facebook post URLs to scrape comments from.

cookies.title: Facebook Cookies
cookies.description: Your Facebook session cookies. Required for authenticated access. Must contain c_user and xs cookies at minimum.

fbDtsg.title: fb_dtsg Token (Optional)
fbDtsg.description: Facebook CSRF token. Leave empty to auto-fetch it from your cookies (recommended).

maxComments.title: Maximum Comments per Post
maxComments.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to scrape per post. Set to 0 for unlimited.

includeReplies.title: Include Replies
includeReplies.description: Also scrape nested replies for each comment. This significantly increases scraping time.

minBatchSize.title: Min Batch Size
minBatchSize.description: Minimum number of requests before triggering a random cooldown.

maxBatchSize.title: Max Batch Size
maxBatchSize.description: Maximum number of requests before triggering a random cooldown.

minCooldownSeconds.title: Min Cooldown (seconds)
minCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum random cooldown duration in seconds.

maxCooldownSeconds.title: Max Cooldown (seconds)
maxCooldownSeconds.description: Maximum random cooldown duration in seconds.

proxyUrl.title: Proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: Custom proxy URL. Format: http://user:pass@host:port. Leave empty for direct connection.

excelExport.title: Export to Excel
excelExport.description: Generate an Excel (.xlsx) file with all scraped comments.
